sources.snippet: Needle is an experimental run for Simple Attention Networks, geared at redefining tiny AI for consumer devices (phones, watches, glasses...). So while it beats FunctionGemma-270m, Qwen-0.6B, Graninte-350m, LFM2.5-350m on single-shot function call for personal AI, Those model are have more scope/capacity and excel in conversational settings.
